brief:
The General Petroleum Authority in Gaza announced the arrival of five cooking gas trucks designated for distribution among 12,217 beneficiaries identified in an August 12 census, Shehab Wire reported. The authority has compiled the initial roster from recent household surveys across the territory.

A second distribution phase is already in preparation, with a new census covering an additional 63,210 families currently underway. Residents selected for either round can verify their eligibility and check their household status through an online verification system established by the authority for the ongoing relief effort.
